Jules (marketing): Heads-up — WK14 KPI deck shows sudden dip in launch-post MQL rate for Mar webinar cohort. Regs steady but MQLs -33% vs prior week. Screenshot: https://dash.redwood/shot/3141 :eyes:
Ari (growth): did we change page or traffic?
Jules (marketing): no config changes on page. small copy tweak Tuesday evening only.
Dana (analytics): quick run shows a window 03/27 02:10-03:00 UTC with many leads missing utm_medium. dashbot flagged enrichment timeouts then.
Noah (ops): saw spike in enrichment latency 02:12 UTC due to a retry storm; I opened INC-2024-2204. Increasing retry budget now.
dashbot: note reprocess recommended for lost enrichment window.
Ari (growth): please reprocess and hold slides until results. execs will want a clean number.
Dana (analytics): kicking job reproc_20240327_0215. ETA ~10m. will attach recovered counts and a small CSV sample.
Jules (marketing): thanks. if reproc fixes it, we'll add an annotated footnote on the KPI slide: "corrected post-reprocessing (enrichment timeout)."
Noah (ops): next steps: longer lambda timeout + alert for `enrichment_retry > 5` in 5m. Also scheduling 30m postmortem with infra and analytics tomorrow.
